paths.transition.md: feat/testing-certification Wave 3 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-10-testing-certification-design.md §8.3): the phase-end half of suite health. A new `suite_health_compare` step, in its own FORK:strategy marker pair, reads the newest SUMMARY's `suite-metrics:` block against the last row of the TEST-STRATEGY `## Suite health` table, derives ms/test there (it is deliberately not recorded twice), and evaluates the T1-T4 trigger table in gsd-core/references/test-strategy.md — which stays the authority; no threshold is re-derived here. T1 writes an immediate pending todo, T2/T3/T4 write a milestone-close todo that complete-milestone's existing audit-open scan surfaces, and both attach the flow that fixes it (`/gsd:testing-strategy --tune-up`). Missing TEST-STRATEGY, missing `## Suite health`, missing `suite-metrics:`, or an `unmeasured` baseline all skip SILENTLY — a phase is never held up for a measurement nobody took — and the step never writes a Suite-health row itself, because re-baselining is the tune-up flow's fourth pass and it appends rather than rewrites. 23374 -> 26438 bytes (+3064), well under the LARGE tier cap (61440). Existing machinery only: no new daemon, no CI plumbing, no new config key. Pinned by tests/testing-certification.test.cjs.
paths.ship.md: feat/testing-certification Wave 3 (spec §5, the optional secondary slot Wave 2 recorded as not falling out of the verify:pre precedent): an advisory milestone certification sweep added as preflight item 8, in its own FORK:strategy marker pair, after the security and broken-windows ship:pre gates and before push_branch. It maps every phase directory in the milestone to the single certification outcome line verify-work's certification step records at the top of that phase's UAT `## Tests` — agentic (CERT-2 | CERT-1 | CERT-1 limited), human (CERT-0), N/A no user-facing change, skipped (declined) — and flags any phase carrying a UAT.md with no `certification:` line as not-run, which is the one state the recorded-never-silent contract does not allow to pass unremarked. It is NOT a capability gate: there is no `certify` capability, and a gates[] `check.predicate` cannot read four prose outcomes across N phases, so this follows the inline numbered-preflight precedent of items 6 and 7 instead. Advisory by construction — it never blocks and deliberately has no --force to teach anyone to type — but never silent: the table prints on the all-green run too, so `every phase certified` is an observed fact rather than an absence of complaint. `workflow.certification: off` skips it silently, because a loop that was never asked to certify has no gap to report. 32012 -> 34917 bytes, well under the LARGE tier cap (61440). Pinned by tests/testing-certification.test.cjs. The sweep SELF-SUPPRESSES from the recorded evidence rather than reading `workflow.certification` inline: ADR-857 Phase 6 (tests/phase6-capstone-conformance.test.cjs) forbids the loop host from resolving a capability-owned config key inline, which is the same shape tests/workflow-compat.test.cjs already bans for workflow.tdd_mode. Zero recorded lines anywhere means certification is not in use on this project — one neutral line, never N flags — which is also the more honest signal, since it describes what happened rather than what the posture happens to be today.
